sourceContradictions.details: Official Hallandsleden page/API says 21 km and red/hard; GPX desc says Total: 21.2 km with computed 21.157 km; Naturkartan visible page says 24.0 km and black/experienced; Pacer/Komoot/Äventyrligare preserve old Ästad-Skattagård 22-24 km style evidence.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Use Hallandsleden official 21 km/red-hard for metadata and official GPX/API computed 21.157 km for geometry evidence. Treat Naturkartan visible metadata and route-app distances as stale old-route evidence.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not import 24 km/black difficulty for current M7.

sourceContradictions.details: Official GPX/API geo_json and Naturkartan shape have the current 214-point Byasjön/Ästad-to-Vessigebro line. API line.geometry and OSM relation 7398314 preserve old Ästad-Skattagård linework that starts east of the current start and continues beyond Vessigebro.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Use official GPX/API geo_json as canonical. Use Naturkartan shape only as corroboration. Suppress API line.geometry and OSM relation 7398314 as current M7 geometry.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Avoid old Skattagård split geometry and endpoint errors.

sourceContradictions.details: Official listing/page previous relationship puts Rydöbruk - Kvarnforsen before Ästad - Vessigebro, but those endpoints are about 44.097 km apart. The actual physical inbound handoff is N7/Åkulla - Ästad, whose endpoint is 0.2 m from M7 start.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Model Mellersta delleden as branched. M7 is the eastern branch continuation from N7/Ästad to M8/Vessigebro-Frodeparken, not a geographic continuation from M6/Kvarnforsen.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Requires branch-aware navigation/order. Do not stitch M6 to M7.

sourceContradictions.issue: official facility over-inclusion and Skattagård legacy
sourceContradictions.details: Page/service narrative and API include Skattagård shelter/camp and broad off-route services, but Skattagård is about 2.62 km from current M7 GPX and belongs to old Ästad-Skattagård/next-stage context.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Suppress Skattagård from current M7 normal import and filter all 50 API records by current-route proximity/currentness.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Prevents wrong-section shelter import and over-dense service records.

sourceContradictions.issue: Byasjön start access versus trailhead parking
sourceContradictions.details: The GPX starts at Byasjön shelter, but this is not drive-up access. Naturkartan says parking at the shelter is unsuitable and access parking is offset through Skogsbo/Holma ö style points.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Model Byasjön as shelter/trail start only. Model Hållplats Ästad, seasonal Åkturen/Skogsbo and Holma ö/Byasjön badplats parking as offset access with caveats.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Avoid promising car access at the route start.

sourceContradictions.details: Fire-ban layer returned no fire ban on 2026-04-29, while Räddningstjänsten Väst showed Brandrisk 3/olämpligt att elda; Långanskogen has reserve-specific fire rules.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Store rules and dynamic-fire warning, not durable no-ban/no-risk status.
